about: Hand-kept source for What came first? (Who died first?). Built by scripts/build-what-came-first.ts into died.json; edit here, then rebuild.

people.label: Abel
people.when: Killed by his brother Cain in the first family, before Seth was born (Genesis 4:8, 25).

people.label: Adam
people.when: Died at 930 (Genesis 5:5).

people.label: Methuselah
people.when: Died at 969 (Genesis 5:27), in the year of the flood by the Bible's own numbers.

people.label: Noah
people.when: Died at 950, 350 years after the flood (Genesis 9:28–29).

people.label: Sarah
people.when: Died at 127 in Hebron, when Isaac was 37 (Genesis 23:1–2).

people.label: Abraham
people.when: Died at 175 (Genesis 25:7–8).

people.label: Ishmael
people.when: Died at 137 (Genesis 25:17).

people.label: Isaac
people.when: Died at 180, buried by Esau and Jacob (Genesis 35:28–29).

people.label: Rebekah
people.when: Scripture records only her burial, which Jacob mentions before his own death (Genesis 49:31). Set by hand from after Sarah's death (Genesis 24:67), about 2078 BC at the earliest, to before Jacob's death, about 1406 BC at the latest; both bounds cover the early and late Exodus dates.

people.label: Rachel
people.when: Died giving birth to Benjamin on the way to Bethlehem (Genesis 35:18–19).

people.label: Jacob
people.when: Died at 147 in Egypt (Genesis 47:28; 49:33).

people.label: Joseph
people.when: Died at 110 in Egypt (Genesis 50:26).

people.label: Miriam
people.when: Died at Kadesh in the wilderness (Numbers 20:1). Set by hand from the Exodus to Aaron's death in the fortieth year after it, about 1495 to 1168 BC, covering the early and late Exodus dates.

people.label: Aaron
people.when: Died at 123 on Mount Hor (Numbers 33:39).

people.label: Moses
people.when: Died at 120 in the land of Moab (Deuteronomy 34:5–7).

people.label: Joshua
people.when: Died at 110 (Joshua 24:29).

people.label: Eglon
people.when: Killed by Ehud after Israel served him eighteen years (Judges 3:14–25).

people.label: Sisera
people.when: Killed by Jael on the day Barak defeated his army (Judges 4:15–21). Set by hand to the Timeline's window for that battle, about 1350–1075 BC, which covers both Exodus dates.

people.label: Gideon
people.when: Died at a ripe old age after forty years of rest (Judges 8:28, 32). Set by hand from the Timeline's earliest date for his victory over Midian, about 1300 BC, to forty years after its latest, about 1015 BC.

people.label: Abimelech
people.when: Killed at Thebez after reigning three years, when a woman dropped a millstone on him (Judges 9:22, 53–54).

people.label: Samson
people.when: Died pulling down the temple of Dagon on the Philistines (Judges 16:30).

people.label: Eli
people.when: Died at 98 when he heard the ark was captured (1 Samuel 4:15, 18).

people.label: Samuel
people.when: Died while David was hiding from Saul, before Saul's death (1 Samuel 25:1; 28:3). Set by hand to Saul's reign on every dating system, from about 1095 BC (Ussher) to about 1002 BC (Albright), widened by a year.

people.label: Saul
people.when: Died on Mount Gilboa at the end of his reign, about 1055 BC (Ussher), 1010 BC (Thiele) or 1002 BC (Albright) (1 Samuel 31:4–6).

people.label: Jonathan
people.when: Killed by the Philistines on Mount Gilboa, the same day as his father Saul (1 Samuel 31:2, 6).

people.label: Goliath
people.when: Killed by the young David in the Valley of Elah (1 Samuel 17:50–51).

people.label: Nabal
people.when: Struck dead by the LORD while David was hiding from Saul (1 Samuel 25:38). Set by hand to Saul's reign on every dating system, from about 1095 BC to about 1002 BC, widened by a year.

people.label: Uzzah
people.when: Struck down beside the ark as David brought it toward Jerusalem (2 Samuel 6:6–7). Set by hand from the Timeline's earliest date for David taking Jerusalem, about 1048 BC, to its latest for the ark entering the city three months later, about 963 BC, widened by a year.

people.label: Amnon
people.when: Killed by Absalom's servants at a sheep-shearing feast (2 Samuel 13:28–32). Set by hand from the Timeline's earliest date for David taking Jerusalem, about 1048 BC, to its latest for Absalom's revolt, about 963 BC, which came at least five years later (13:38; 14:28).

people.label: Absalom
people.when: Killed by Joab and his men in the battle that ended his revolt (2 Samuel 18:14–15). Set by hand to the Timeline's window for that revolt, about 1037–963 BC, widened by a year.

people.label: David
people.when: Died at the end of his forty-year reign: about 1015 BC (Ussher), 970 BC (Thiele) or 962 BC (Albright) (1 Kings 2:10–11).

people.label: Joab
people.when: Killed at the altar early in Solomon's reign, before Shimei's three years were up (1 Kings 2:28–39).

people.label: Solomon
people.when: Died at the end of his forty-year reign: about 975 BC (Ussher), 931 BC (Thiele) or 922 BC (Albright) (1 Kings 11:42–43).

people.label: Ahab
people.when: Killed in battle at the end of his reign: about 897 BC (Ussher), 853 BC (Thiele) or 850 BC (Albright) (1 Kings 22:34–37).

people.label: Jezebel
people.when: Thrown from a window the day Jehu took power (2 Kings 9:30–35).

people.label: Jehu
people.when: Died after reigning twenty-eight years: about 856 BC (Ussher), 815 BC (Albright) or 814 BC (Thiele) (2 Kings 10:35–36).

people.label: Elisha
people.when: Died of an illness in the reign of Jehoash of Israel (2 Kings 13:14, 20).

people.label: Josiah
people.when: Killed by Pharaoh Neco at Megiddo at the end of his reign, about 610 or 609 BC (2 Kings 23:29).

people.label: Belshazzar
people.when: Slain the night of the writing on the wall, when Babylon fell (Daniel 5:30). Set by hand to Babylon's fall to the Persians: 539 BC from Babylonian records, 538 BC on Ussher's count, widened by a year.

people.label: Haman
people.when: Hanged on the gallows he built for Mordecai, in the twelfth year of Xerxes (Esther 3:7; 7:10).

people.label: Herod the Great
people.when: Died while the young Jesus was in Egypt (Matthew 2:15, 19): about 4 BC on most reckonings of Josephus, 1 BC on a minority view.

people.label: John the Baptist
people.when: Beheaded in prison by Herod Antipas during Jesus' ministry (Matthew 14:10).

people.label: Judas Iscariot
people.when: Hanged himself when he saw that Jesus was condemned (Matthew 27:3–5). Set by hand to the crucifixion's window, about AD 30–33.

people.label: Ananias
people.when: Fell dead after lying about the price of his land (Acts 5:1–5).

people.label: Sapphira
people.when: Fell dead about three hours after her husband (Acts 5:7–10).

people.label: Stephen
people.when: Stoned outside Jerusalem while Saul of Tarsus looked on (Acts 7:58–60).

people.label: James son of Zebedee
people.when: Put to death with the sword by Herod Agrippa I (Acts 12:1–2).

people.label: Herod Agrippa I
people.when: Struck down by an angel at Caesarea, about AD 44 (Acts 12:23).

leftOut.name: Terah
leftOut.reason: Genesis 11:26, 11:32 and Acts 7:4 leave Abraham's birth year against Terah's open by sixty years, so Terah's death against Abraham's move and the deaths near it is not settled.

leftOut.name: Lamech (Noah's father)
leftOut.reason: The Hebrew numbers put his death five years before Methuselah's, but the Greek and Samaritan numbers differ.

leftOut.name: Nadab and Abihu
leftOut.reason: They died at the same moment (Leviticus 10:2), and either alone adds little to the game.

leftOut.name: Korah, Dathan and Abiram
leftOut.reason: They died in the same event (Numbers 16:31–35).

leftOut.name: Abinadab and Malchishua
leftOut.reason: Saul's sons died the same day as Saul and Jonathan (1 Samuel 31:2–6), so every pair among them would be blocked.
